page_title: BHA 1-1 FUL | Brighton v Fulham 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+10' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
90+9' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Fulham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+9' Michael Salisbury blows the whistle, Billy Gilmour (Brighton) is penalised for a foul.
90+5' Pascal Gross (Brighton) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
90+4' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom right corner is far too weak and Jason Steele makes a simple save.
90+2' Here comes a substitution. Sasa Lukic (Fulham) is brought on as a substitute for Alex Iwobi.
90' Harry Wilson (Fulham) receives a yellow card.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brighton comes to nothing.
89' Adam Webster (Brighton) meets a cross and produces a header towards the left side of the goal, but one of the defending players blocks the effort.
89' Brighton have been awarded a corner kick.
88' Brighton earn a corner.
88' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
86' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tom Cairney (Fulham) replacing Willian.
86' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
86' The game is interrupted now, Joao Palhinha (Fulham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
85' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
83' Ansu Fati (Brighton) skips past a few defenders in the penalty area and strikes a low shot towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his effort with a superb save.
82' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
82' A quickly taken corner by Brighton.
82' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Brighton have a corner.
81' Pascal Gross (Brighton) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Joao Pedro (Brighton) is replacing Evan Ferguson.
78' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Michael Salisbury ignores the protests.
77' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Fulham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
76' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
75' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
74' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
73' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Salisbury had an easy-decision to make.
71' It is time for a substitution. Joel Veltman (Brighton) is on for Simon Adingra.
71' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to substitute Carlos Baleba and he is replaced by Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton).
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Billy Gilmour (Brighton) is coming onto the pitch as Mahmoud Dahoud cannot continue after picking up an injury.
70' Mahmoud Dahoud (Brighton) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
69' Fulham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

68' What a wasted opportunity by Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Jason Steele makes a comfortable save to thwart him. Fulham win a corner.

65' 1 - 1 Goal! Harry Wilson puts Joao Palhinha (Fulham) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully into the top right corner. 1:1.

64' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Jason Steele!
61' That's a well-taken pass by Carlos Baleba (Brighton). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
59' Substitution. Ansu Fati (Brighton) on for Adam Lallana.
58' It will be a substitution. Harry Wilson (Fulham) is ready to enter the pitch as Bobby De Cordova-Reid walks off.
58' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Raul Jimenez will be replaced by Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham).
58' Substitution. Andreas Pereira (Fulham) has come on for Harrison Reed.
56' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) commits a rough challenge and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul.
55' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
53' Willian (Fulham) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Jason Steele.
50' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
49' Harrison Reed (Fulham) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Brighton.
47' Pascal Gross (Brighton) was too forceful with his tackle and Michael Salisbury interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
45+2' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
42' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
41' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Bernd Leno has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
39' Willian plays a beautiful lofted pass to Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham), who somehow crashes the ball miles over the bar from a promising position.
36' Fulham have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
34' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
34' Willian (Fulham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

33' Harrison Reed (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
32' Brighton are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
26' 1 - 0 Goal! Evan Ferguson (Brighton) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
24' Brighton take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
24' Adam Lallana (Brighton) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The linesman makes the right call and Brighton will have a corner.
23' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes a short corner kick.

23' Mahmoud Dahoud (Brighton) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. Brighton can continue in their attacking effort.
22' The ball is behind the touchline and Brighton will take a throw-in.
19' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) makes a strong challenge and Michael Salisbury blows for a foul.
17' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it well wide of the right post.
16' Simon Adingra (Brighton) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
14' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
11' The resulting set piece from Fulham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
10' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Good work from Fulham as they win a corner.
8' Brighton will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

8' A sweet pass finds Carlos Baleba (Brighton) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Bernd Leno is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
7' The ball is cleared after Simon Adingra (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
6' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
5' Willian (Fulham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
4' Brighton enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Fulham will kick the game off.
Michael Salisbury was nominated as the referee for this game.
